skill: M02 狂暴（镇魇白虎 Boss）

parameters.prompt: The exact upright white tiger warrior in the reference performs ONE rage-activation howl in place. From the resting pose it crouches slightly, spreads both clawed arms wide, then rears up, throws the head back with the muzzle pointing to the sky and the jaw open, and holds the howl. Keep the same three-quarter left view, tiger head, white striped fur, armor and kilt. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Exactly two arms and two legs. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. No jump, walking, turning, extra limbs, weapon, glow, aura, energy, red colour change, dust, rocks, cracks, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: crouch and spread over the first second, the howl opens around one and a half seconds and is held to three seconds, then recover and hold the original pose.
